reviews.name: operand_behavior_differences
reviews.requirement: Verified per-instruction behavior comparison and retained oracle tests; source arm counts cannot establish equivalence.

reviews.name: duplicated_per_item_stages
reviews.requirement: Reviewed stage execution ownership, backed by verified generated stage tables and pipeline differential probes.

reviews.name: nested_machine_bounds
reviews.requirement: Review each entry call and constructor for native-stack nesting and the accepted counter bound; lexical calls alone do not prove scheduling.

reviews.name: instruction_fallback_arms
reviews.requirement: Verified generated instruction dispatch inventory identifying recursive fallback routes.

reviews.name: name_resolution_authorities
reviews.requirement: Reviewed authority boundaries and feature-touch evidence; source definitions do not prove semantic authority.

reviews.name: lint_recursive_descents
reviews.requirement: Verified traversal inventory and rule probes identifying independent recursive descents.

reviews.name: module_checks_per_pass
reviews.requirement: Measured single lint-pass module-check counts with the shared-import fixture.

reviews.name: whole_program_stage_copies
reviews.requirement: Reviewed stage-lowering ownership and allocation probes; arbitrary clone calls are not a semantic count.

reviews.name: open_defects
reviews.requirement: Reviewed TODO defect dispositions with retained regression coverage and recorded reasons.

reviews.name: timings
reviews.requirement: Isolated repository lint and full gate wall-clock measurements; timings are evidence without a rise ratchet.
